pages.title: Boomstick
pages.text: The Boomstick is a volatile weapon but can be extremely effective if the user has no regard for the space around them; or for their own safety. Upon hitting an enemy with it, the dynamite stick on its end will explode, hurting the user as well. The Boomstick will not be consumed after one explosion and can be reused several times. It can also be repaired with TNT.

Additionally, the Boomstick can be thrown too. It will only explode when hitting creatures and the explosion will shoot it in a random direction. Not only can this cause chain explosions, but can also ricochet back and explode the user. If it is enchanted with

Loyalty, the Boomstick will guarantied explode on return. Other enchantments change the behaviour of the explosions: Flame adds fire to them; Power increases their strength; and Wind Burst turns them non-harmful. $(br)$(br)Note: Do not let a Zombie or any other mob get hold of a Boomstick. Unlike with a Creeper, there will be no windup to the explosion.
